review_type: Prospective generic bounded-turn scheduling technical review only
meaning: No blocking internal inconsistency in scheduling proposal. Not proof of runtime compliance, blindness, source reading, factual completeness or adoption eligibility.

adoption_prerequisite.requirement: All current full reader outputs must be primary-graded before adoption or new reader pair dispatch.

operational_limits.limit: Normal final-channel progress ends a turn only; parent must resume same actor and distinguish whole-task completion.
Use unchanged checker against original full bank; require exact_ordered_unique_ids and structural flag. Source-record coverage is separately checked.
Persisted exact ordered prefix plus actual per-ID records determines progress; reconcile interrupted paired writes from own inputs/work without invented semantics.
Freeze first actual full draft bytes immediately; repairs and review metadata go into final/self-check, never a rewritten full draft.
Full initial receipt remains a global pre-write gate even if initial delivery spans turns. At-most-ten does not guarantee eventual progress.

nonblocking_clarifications: Explicitly describe next_unfinished_id:null when N entries and records exist but required finalization is pending.
Say before the first output write in any turn to remove a possible misreading when initial receipt spans turns.
generic_continuation_template: Continue this same blind task under the unchanged protocol. Resume the next unfinished question from your own draft. Complete at most ten additional ordered questions, using only the original two inputs and your own three files. If all entries and per-ID records already exist, preserve the first complete draft and finish finalization. A partial turn is progress only; the entire original bank remains required.
blindness_limits: Use fixed generic continuation independent of factual performance; no failed IDs, source maps, facts, keys, hints, grades or other reader work. Actual same-context identity and hidden context isolation require runtime enforcement not inspected here.

neutral_evidence.meaning: Review-only scheduling/schema reference model plus neutral existing-checker prefix example; not an adopted scheduler, semantic grader or actual reader run.
